inventory.notes: One donkey with red glasses and pink bandana, no tack; four legs counted; one easel; one teal cable to one small pale server tower on the horizon. Tool: steel tuning fork. Canvas: teal speaker cone with concentric arcs in teal to violet filling the canvas. No text or logos. Inspected at 554px on a contact sheet and at 72px, not on quadrant crops.

orientation.notes: Donkey in profile facing right, reaching on three legs, hindquarters low and back, one front leg planted, other extended; canvas content follows the canvas's three-quarter perspective inside its edges.

contact.notes: Grounded hooves sit on the ground shadow; the raised hoof holds: steel tuning fork; easel legs on the ground; cable meets the easel foot and the tower base.
